concept: Torque from position vector and force
source_note: Ground truth for the torque lesson. Angles in degrees, 0=right, 90=up. Renderer must reproduce exactly.

vectors.label: r
vectors.meaning: position vector from pivot to point of application

vectors.label: F
vectors.meaning: force applied at tip of r

reasoning.eq: r at 55°, F at 90° from tip of r

takeaway: A force far from the pivot with θ near 90° gives maximal torque — like pushing a door at the handle.
